title: Genesis 7:8-10 — animals go into the ark by twos
summary: Genesis 7:8-10 in English with the Hebrew reference: clean and unclean animals, birds and creeping things went into the ark to Noah by twos, male and female, and after seven days the flood waters came. A few letters (the 'ar' of ark, 'No' of Noah, 'God') are coloured.

text.text: 8 Of clean animals and animals that are not clean and birds and everything that creeps on the ground,
9 there went into the ark to Noah by twos, male and female, as God had commanded Noah.
10 It came about after the seven days, that the water of the flood came upon the earth.

numbers.note: the seven days before the flood waters came
